decisions.q: Part2 roadmap 初始结构怎么建？
decisions.answer: 按实施流建结构：Phase 2 strict parity -> init/config/doctor/schema/package-bin -> migration cleanup/final validation

decisions.q: Part1/Part2 的切分边界按哪个粒度？
decisions.answer: 按完成状态切：已 completed 的全部进入 Part1；未 completed 的 Phase 2 进入 Part2

decisions.q: Part2 新 roadmap 的范围怎么定义？
